name: Orbiting light ball
what: A word waits unseen in the dark; a glowing ball swings in from the left, circles it once on a wide oval and flies off over the top. Each letter lights up as the ball comes near and dims as it moves away, so the light travels around the word.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f13-f24 the ball swings in from the left edge and climbs onto an oval around the word (f16 at the edge, top of the oval f24); f24-f113 it circles clockwise (right f59, bottom f72, left f113), fast through the lower right (f66-f71, about 100 px a frame, blurred) and slow along the lower left; f113-f126 it climbs over the top and flies off at the right edge with a long blur; each letter's light follows its distance to the ball (full within about 300 px, none beyond about 650 px of the 1280-px original)

tracks.name: ball in
tracks.what: the ball swings in from the left edge and climbs onto the oval (blurred, accelerating)

tracks.name: ball loop
tracks.what: the ball circles the word clockwise on a wide oval, 60 px far and 80 px near
tracks.easing: S-curve (fast lower right, slow lower left), measured path

tracks.name: ball out
tracks.what: the ball climbs over the top and flies off at the right edge with a long blur

tracks.name: letter light
tracks.what: each letter's light follows its distance to the ball (full near, none far)
